attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long spine.** Columns 0 to 19, `oxyR` to `metF` through the `arg` and `pfl` genes, are spine columns carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 3% of calls. The model names 89 to 100% of genes there, fewest at `argH`, 89%, where it hesitates 0.50 bits.

**A single variable column follows**, column 20, a hypothetical protein at 63%, named 89%, 0.49 bits. Then columns 21 to 46, `metL` to `fieF` through the `met`, `hsl` and `glp` genes, are spine again, 95 to 99%, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.4 to 14% of calls. The model names 75 to 99% of genes, fewest at `rpmE`, 75%, its most hesitant spine column at 0.60 bits.

**The graph opens at column 47.** Columns 47 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 6 to 76% of calls, named 65 to 96%, fewest at column 54, 65%, most hesitant at column 79, 0.68 bits. A branch of 8 families runs through columns 47 to 54, carried by 11 to 13% of chromosomes, all shell, from `ogrK` to a phage tail sheath protein. A branch of 10 families runs through columns 63 to 72, 10 to 11%, all shell, from a phage virion morphogenesis protein to a phage terminase small subunit. A branch of 3 families runs through columns 74 to 76, 13 to 15%, all shell, `nadS` to an alpha/beta hydrolase.

**The `rha` genes sit in variable columns 55 to 59**, [[rhamnose transport and catabolism]], carried by 83 to 84% of chromosomes, all persistent. The model names genes inside a region of plasticity in 80% of calls against 96% outside, and hesitates 0.85 bits against 0.16. The window ends at `yihT`, column 79, in 31% of chromosomes.

label: oxyR
facts:
WINDOW: the oxyR window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor oxyR, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,161 to 4,240 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying oxyR once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.26 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,829 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; shell 7,746 calls, named 81%, 0.70 bits; cloud 545 calls, named 22%, 2.62 bits. Outside an RGP 36,724 calls, named 96%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 6,396 calls, named 80%, 0.85 bits. Columns: 46 spine, 24 fork, 10 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.85 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 96%); 6,396 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 79 (yihT) 0.68 bits, RGP 76%; column 78 (yihU) 0.63 bits, RGP 73%; column 25 (rpmE) 0.60 bits, RGP 12%. The 8 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.52 bits on average; the other 72 columns: named 95%, 0.23 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 47-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 6-76%; the least: columns 0-19 (spine), RGP 0-3%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-19 (20 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-3%. Genes: oxyR, argH, argB "acetylglutamate kinase", argC, argE, ppc, eptC, yijO "AraC family transcriptional regulat…", frwD, pflC, pflD "pyruvate formate lyase family prote…", frwB "PTS fructose-like transporter subun…", frwC, ptsP, fsa, gldA, yijF "DUF1287 domain-containing protein", yijE, katG, metF. named 89-100% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1 (argH), named 89%, 0.50 bits.
2. column 20 variable: RGP 2%. named 89%; 0.49 bits.
   20: "hypothetical protein" S 63%
3. columns 21-46 (26 columns) spine: share 95-99%, all P, RGP 0.4-14%. Genes: metL, metB "PLP-dependent transferase", metJ, yiiX "YiiX family permuted papain-like en…", rpmE, priA, cytR, ftsN, hslV, hslU "HslU--HslV peptidase ATPase subunit", menA, rraA, zapB, glpF, glpK "FGGY family carbohydrate kinase", glpX, fpr, uspD, yiiS "DUF406 domain-containing protein", yiiR "DUF805 domain-containing protein", yiiQ "YiiQ family protein", tpiA, cdh, sbp, pfkA, fieF. named 75-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 25 (rpmE), named 75%, 0.60 bits.
4. columns 47-79 (33 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 6-76%. named 65-96% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 54, named 65%; most hesitant at column 79, 0.68 bits.

   a second branch of 3 families through columns 74-76, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 13-15%, all S; the branch's families: nadS, "hypothetical protein", "alpha/beta hydrolase"
